title: An ESP32 based plane radar for my desk
summary: A maker built a compact desk-sized radar system using an ESP32 microcontroller to receive and display real-time aircraft tracking data via ADS-B signals. The project combines hardware assembly with software programming to create a functional radar that shows nearby planes on a display.
problem_solved: Provides an accessible way to track real aircraft in real-time using affordable hardware and open-source software for hobbyists and makers.
why_valuable: It offers a hands-on learning experience combining RF technology, embedded programming, and aviation data while creating a visually impressive and functional desk accessory.
